name: HJ v2 stage A gate (docs/HJ_V2.md section 3)
written: 2026-10-23, before any stage-A margin was computed
data: eval/hj_margin.py on paired_record_ocl (topple windows kt-10..kt + every 4th no-topple episode); hold plan from the current state, model_OIL, 64 futures, scales 0.5,1,2,3,4,8
smoothness: median |l_{k+1} - l_k| / IQR(l) on consecutive safe-episode decisions (lower = smoother)
information: AUC(-l): decisions 1-3 chunks before the topple start vs safe-episode decisions
pass: AUC_1-3 >= 0.70 AND smoother than h_bin (or h_bin's IQR is 0); among passing margins the highest AUC_4-6 goes to stage B
note: dev only (these episodes already informed the trigger rules); stage B is judged on held-out episodes
amendment_1: 2026-10-23, after inspecting the raw D values of 4 decisions of one safe episode, before any AUC/smoothness was computed: Ashman D is degenerate as a continuous margin (>= 2 for unimodal 64-sample clouds, ~3), so negD_2 / negD_4 are replaced by the joint BIC gain (min over hold-10/30 endings): negG_2, negG_4, negG_max; h_cont now interpolates the scale where the joint BIC gain crosses 0. neg_gain_4 is the same as negG_4 and is dropped.

result.why: the smoothness reference is degenerate: h_bin's median consecutive step is 0 (it sits at its cap), so no margin can be 'smoother' by that statistic (h_cont ties at 0). Information criterion AUC_1-3 >= 0.70: h_bin 0.726, h_cont 0.725, negG_max 0.775, neg_log_sens_4 0.787 (others < 0.70).
result.continuation: exploratory, flagged: stage B proceeds with the margin the pre-declared tie-break picks among AUC-passing continuous margins (highest AUC_4-6): negG_max (0.657; neg_log_sens_4 0.653 as declared secondary). Stage B's own gate on held-out episodes is the decisive test.
